QB5 0.9879
QB5 has the highest readout fidelity on sirius in the current default calibration. Its fidelity is 0.9879, with an uncertainty of about 0.0011.
The default calibration set ID is e3e7b570-0fdf-4c7f-b6e5-c94c2e93157a. I read it with IQMClient.get_dynamic_quantum_architecture() and then called get_calibration_quality_metrics on that set. The metric is metrics.ssro.measure_fidelity.constant.QBn.fidelity.
Readout fidelity is reported for 16 qubits. QB9 is second at 0.9861 and QB3 is third at 0.985. The lowest is QB4 at 0.9748.
The architecture lists 24 qubits. QB6, QB7, QB12, QB14, QB16, QB18, QB22 and QB24 have no readout fidelity entry.
I submitted no jobs. My query script is /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_b84e5732-d62-2/scratch_t12.py. The raw metric data is in qm_*.json files in the same folder.
